title: Underwriting Note on the Corrected Declared Trip Cost of a Travel Protection Plans Certificate
content:
A Travel Protection Plans certificate bought alongside a vacation package is declared on the prepaid outlay standing against the journey insured on that package, and where the two differ the certificate is corrected to that outlay.

**The prepaid outlay.** It is taken as the package's quoted price.

**What comes off it.** The amounts the operator has returned against the package otherwise than on the surrender of the journey are recognised at 0 per cent and taken off the outlay. What the operator returns on the surrender of the journey itself is left out of that quantity, because the declared trip cost states what stood at risk before the journey was given up, while what comes back on the surrender answers the loss rather than the declaration.

**The share declared.** The share of the outlay the certificate declares is the whole of it, 100 per cent.

**The corrected figure.** The corrected declared trip cost is the outlay so taken, rounded to two decimal places, and it is never declared above the ceiling that applies to it. The ceiling that applies is the package's quoted price.

## The quantity defined in order

The prepaid outlay is established first, and the recognised part of the operator's returns other than those on the surrender of the journey is taken off it. That figure is then taken at the share of the outlay the certificate declares, giving the outlay so taken. The outlay so taken is then set beside the ceiling that applies, and the lesser of the two is the corrected declared trip cost, which is rounded to two decimal places. The rounding is done last, after the ceiling has been applied.

## Worked to a figure on hypothetical inputs

Take a certificate bought alongside a vacation package whose quoted price is 7000.00 USD, on which the operator has returned 600.00 USD otherwise than on the surrender of the journey.

- The prepaid outlay is the package's quoted price, 7000.00 USD.
- The operator's returns other than those on the surrender of the journey are recognised at 0 per cent, which is 0.00 USD, so nothing comes off the outlay and it stands at 7000.00 USD.
- The share of the outlay the certificate declares is 100 per cent, so the outlay so taken is 7000.00 USD.
- The ceiling that applies is the package's quoted price, 7000.00 USD, and the outlay so taken does not exceed it.
- Rounded to two decimal places, the corrected declared trip cost is 7000.00 USD.
